data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the Scheme is to generate returns that are commensurate (before fees and expenses) with the performance of the HDFC NIFTY PSU Bank Index (TRI), over long term, subject to tracking error. There is no assurance that the investment objective of the Scheme will be achieved.
